title: MCP argument, REST and client: set, show and cancel a timer
goal: NERV and the client can set a timed switch and see or cancel it
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "yes to both", including a timed switch in Grover ("spegni il ventilatore per 2 ore") via MCP behind NERV's approval. Italian is required for every model-facing feature.

grover_switch inputSchema gains durationMinutes (zod int, bounded); the description still starts "CHANGES HARDWARE STATE" and names the revert; annotations unchanged so NERV asks the owner first as today

The REST switch route takes the same field; the client shows the remaining time on the actuator with a cancel button (style guide tokens, Italian and English); the DESIGN.md tool table and the e2e MCP test updated
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one schema field, one route and a client badge with cancel. Not a measurement.
